title: Layout Editor drawer handle drag
summary: Add pointer-driven drag/reorder behavior to the Layout Editor drawer grip with held-row visual feedback and focused smoke coverage.
reason: The drawer's visible move handle implied direct drag placement, but the existing native drag path did not reliably behave that way or show a held-state cue.
behavior_before: Layout Editor drawer rows exposed a grip and native draggable rows, but grabbing the grip did not provide a reliable pointer-drag interaction or shrink/jiggle held-state feedback.
behavior_after: Layout Editor drawer grip pointerdown starts a scoped pointer drag within the same drawer group, highlights drop targets, saves order through existing layout persistence, and shows restrained held-row feedback with reduced-motion fallback.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src bundled python browser layout-manager unittest - passed
PYTHONPATH=src bundled python full css+layout unittest command - failed before feature assertions only on pre-existing styles.components.css raw rgba token violations
PYTHONPATH=src bundled python targeted CSS ownership test - passed
refresh_summaries --paths layout manager drawer drag files - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the drawer pointer-drag helpers, held-row CSS/keyframes, focused test assertions, refreshed summaries for these files, and this change packet.
notes:
Adds pointer-based drag handling and restrained held-state feedback for Layout Editor drawer rows.
Strict worktree coverage passed after adding refreshed summaries; the broader CSS token suite still reports unrelated raw colors in styles.components.css lines 329 and 346.
